name: JoinWell52 AI Editorial Evaluation
purpose: A weekly self-evaluation of published observation notes. It measures relative editorial and research maturity; it is not a publication gate or peer review.
purpose_zh: 对已发布观察笔记进行每周自我评价，衡量相对编辑质量与研究成熟度；它不是发布门禁，也不等同于同行评审。

scoring.totalRule: The total is the exact sum of the four dimension scores. Manual total overrides are prohibited.
scoring.totalRule_zh: 总分必须等于四个分项分数之和，禁止手工覆盖总分。

dimensions.name: Evidence and rigor
tests: Claims are traceable to identifiable sources or first-party artifacts.
Facts, source claims, observations and judgments are not conflated.
Versions, uncertainty, counterevidence and extrapolation limits are explicit when material.

anchors.meaning: Primary evidence is traceable, competing evidence is handled, and boundaries are explicit.
Evidence is strong and traceable with limited omissions or weak independent corroboration.
Core claims are supported, but source diversity, counterevidence or boundary handling is incomplete.
Material claims are weakly sourced, untraceable or insufficiently bounded.

dimensions.name: Original judgment
tests: The article makes an explicit, non-trivial judgment rather than only summarizing sources.
The reasoning explains mechanisms, trade-offs or relationships.
The judgment stays within the evidence and distinguishes novelty from restatement.

anchors.meaning: A distinctive, well-supported judgment reorganizes how the problem is understood.
The article contributes a clear synthesis or useful bounded judgment.
Some analysis is present, but the contribution remains close to source summary.
The article is primarily descriptive or its judgment is unsupported.

dimensions.name: Structure and expression
tests: The research question, findings and reasoning path are easy to locate.
Sections add information value without mechanical repetition.
Terminology, tables, figures and bilingual surfaces preserve meaning and readability.

anchors.meaning: The argument is exceptionally clear, economical and independently readable.
The structure is coherent with minor repetition, density or navigation cost.
The main line is recoverable, but compression, sequencing or terminology needs work.
The argument is difficult to follow or materially incomplete as a public article.

dimensions.name: Engineering usefulness
tests: The article yields actionable design, validation or operating implications.
Implementation boundaries and prerequisites are explicit.
Readers can identify a next decision, experiment, check or reusable model.

anchors.meaning: The work directly changes an engineering decision or provides a reusable validation model.
The implications are actionable but require some local interpretation.
The article is informative, but concrete next actions or boundaries are limited.
Engineering relevance is weak, generic or not demonstrated.

cadence.weeklyScope: Score every newly published or content-changed eligible note; inherit unchanged scores by content hash and audit at least 10% of inherited notes.
cadence.monthlyCalibration: On the first Sunday of each month, rescore the complete eligible corpus.
cadence.completionRule: A weekly snapshot is Completed only when every eligible note has a scored or hash-inherited item and the coverage rate is 100%.

publicationSeparation.dailyGate: Publication uses binary editorial and evidence gates without a numeric score.
publicationSeparation.weeklyEvaluation: Weekly scoring evaluates already-published work and may legitimately produce any score from 0 to 100.
publicationSeparation.lowScoreAction: A low score is retained as self-evaluation evidence and may create an improvement candidate; it does not automatically unpublish an article.

publicDisplay.rule: Public pages show only the five public labels; E1-E5 are internal machine fields.
